description: Analyse a string at the Unicode level: apply NFC, NFD, NFKC or NFKD, report which forms it is already in, list the scripts present (all Unicode scripts), and flag confusable and homoglyph characters — Cyrillic а in a Latin word, fullwidth or mathematical look-alikes, all-look-alike words — plus zero-width joiners, bidirectional overrides, invisible and blank characters. Returns per-character detail with code points, names and the ASCII character each imitates. Price: $0.05 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base).

detail.description: summary (default) or full per-code-point detail (capped at 256 entries). Accepted: summary, full.

form.description: Normalisation form to apply, default nfc. Accepted: nfc, nfd, nfkc or nfkd.

text.description: Text to analyse, at most 1024 characters. Accepted: at most 1024 characters.

name: text_unicode
title: Unicode normalisation, script detection and confusable/homoglyph analysis
